title: The Oxford Handbook of Philosophy of Time
relevance: Reference spine spanning metaphysics, experience, action and physics.
limits: Publisher overview and contents checked; individual chapters not audited by this record.

title: What Makes Time Special?
relevance: Physical versus manifest time; experience and explanatory alternatives to robust passage.
limits: Publisher abstract and contents inspected; not a full book review or endorsement.

title: The Metaphysics Within Physics
relevance: Physics-informed metaphysics that makes room for passage and primitive laws; counterweight to reductive assumptions.
limits: Publisher abstract and contents inspected; chapter arguments not reconstructed.

title: The 2020 PhilPapers Survey: main results and temporal ontology
relevance: Sociological context for expert views; distinguishes plurality from consensus.
limits: Results and denominator/exclusion notes checked, not raw-data reanalysis. Survey populations and overlapping endorsements are not probabilities of philosophical truth.

title: The Unreality of Time
relevance: A/B/C series, change requirement, A-determination contradiction and regress.
limits: Publisher metadata and selected public-domain transcription passages inspected, especially change and C-series discussion; whole argument and transcription not independently audited.

title: Real Time II
relevance: Systematic tenseless account; truthmakers, indexicals, experience, change, causation and direction.
limits: Publisher description and contents checked; no full-text audit.

title: A Future for Presentism
relevance: Direct presentist defense concerning truthmakers, future contingents, causation and relativity/cosmology.
limits: Publisher abstract and contents checked; reported solutions are author's claims, not established by this record.

title: Nothing To Come: A Defence of the Growing Block Theory of Time
relevance: Specific GBT formulation; epistemic objection, tense, quantification, future contingents and relativity.
limits: Publisher overview and chapter contents inspected; no reconstruction of proofs or full replies.

title: The Moving Spotlight: An Essay on Time and Ontology
relevance: Direct spotlight defense; distinguish full ontology from changing presentness and variant-specific openness claims.
limits: Publisher abstract checked; full consistency and epistemic arguments remain to read.

title: Objective Becoming
relevance: Distinguishes anemic from robust passage; evaluates spotlight consistency, rate, SR compatibility and experience while defending a block account.
limits: Publisher abstract and contents checked; rejecting robust passage and defending spotlight consistency are different claims, not a contradiction.

title: Modality and Tense: Philosophical Papers, especially Tense and Reality
relevance: Nonstandard tense realism without a privileged temporal standpoint; fragmentalism.
limits: Book abstract and chapter listing inspected; exact fragment semantics and SR applications not audited.

title: How do we know it is now now?
relevance: Epistemic latest-edge objection relevant to growing-block theories.
limits: Luna reviewer checked metadata/abstract; coordinator publisher-page retrieval failed. Objection and replies need direct full-text audit.

title: Thank Goodness That's Over
relevance: Tensed attitudes and relief; tests inference from temporal thought to irreducibly tensed reality.
limits: Bibliographic metadata checked; agent inspected preview. Not a complete reconstruction or proof of presentism.

title: The Problem of the Essential Indexical
relevance: De se/self-locating content and action; separate indexical necessity from ontological presentness.
limits: Reviewer checked original metadata; coordinator checked publisher record for the collected essays, not the complete original article.

title: Four-Dimensionalism: An Ontology of Persistence and Time
relevance: Temporal parts, persistence and associated but separable ontological theses.
limits: Publisher abstract checked; definitions, compatibility claims and book arguments require full-text audit. Do not equate a spacetime dimension count with perdurantism.

title: Branching Space-Time
relevance: Formal causal ordering of possible events, histories and choice points; branching need not be a metaphysical conclusion.
limits: Original metadata/abstract surfaced; theorem axioms not audited. A branching formal model does not guarantee physically realistic histories without further conditions.

title: Time Without Change
relevance: Modal relation between time and change, local versus global freezes.
limits: Bibliography checked; original text not retrieved from publisher in this pass. Treat as argument to reconstruct, not an experiment or settled proof.

title: Smoothness of time functions and the metric splitting of globally hyperbolic spacetimes
relevance: Global hyperbolicity permits smooth Cauchy slicing; existence versus unique preferred time.
limits: arXiv abstract checked, not proof reproduced; article published 2005 after 2004 preprint, version not pinned for theorem reuse.

title: Lorentz-Violating Extension of the Standard Model
relevance: Distinguish observer-coordinate covariance and physical particle Lorentz symmetry.
limits: Primary record/abstract checked; coefficients, bounds and experiments not audited; not an empirical test of presentism.

title: The Thermodynamic Arrow: Puzzles and Pseudo-puzzles
relevance: Explanatory questions concerning entropy gradients, low-entropy past and asymmetric reasoning.
limits: Abstract checked, not complete argument or statistical derivation; not a temporal-ontology verdict.

title: Asymmetries in Time: Problems in the Philosophy of Science
relevance: Memory, knowledge, causation and thermodynamic asymmetries as separable explanatory problems.
limits: Reviewer checked publisher record; coordinator has not audited book text.

title: Relative State Formulation of Quantum Mechanics
relevance: Unitary relative-state formulation; distinguish physical state dynamics from a temporal ontology.
limits: Reviewer inspected primary metadata/abstract; no measurement, probability or ontology argument reproduced.

title: Unified dynamics for microscopic and macroscopic systems
relevance: Explicit stochastic dynamical alternative; indeterminism is not presentism by definition.
limits: Reviewer checked primary abstract; parameters, relativistic extensions and experimental limits not reviewed.

title: Hypersurface Bohm-Dirac models
relevance: Specified foliation structure in Bohmian Dirac models; covariance and statistical interpretation need model-level treatment.
limits: Abstract checked: entangled but noninteracting Dirac particles. Preprint 1998, publication 1999. No universal claim about all foliations or empirically hidden structure follows.

title: Von Neumann Algebra Automorphisms and Time-Thermodynamics Relation in General Covariant Quantum Theories
relevance: Thermal-time hypothesis connects state/algebra modular flow with physical time roles.
limits: Abstract checked, not modular-theory derivation or empirical validation; identification of mathematical flow as physical time is a hypothesis. Version not pinned for reuse.

title: The Problem of Time in Quantum Gravity
relevance: Multiple facets/strategies for the problem of time rather than a consensus that time is unreal.
limits: Abstract checked; primary strategy proofs and any later resolution must be separately audited. This is a review, not a new no-time theorem.

title: Spacetime is as spacetime does
relevance: Functional recovery of empirically relevant spacetime roles from nonspatiotemporal structures; empirical-coherence burden.
limits: Author abstract checked; sufficiency of role recovery is an argued philosophical proposal, not an established reduction. Quantum-gravity examples not reproduced.

title: The Principles of Psychology, volume I, chapter XV: The Perception of Time
relevance: Specious present, duration and temporally broad awareness; historical comparator.
limits: Chapter located; reviewer checked selected passages. Not contemporary experimental consensus or a full chapter audit.

title: On the Phenomenology of the Consciousness of Internal Time (1893-1917)
relevance: Retention, protention and temporal-object awareness as phenomenological issues.
limits: 1991 John Barnett Brough translation metadata checked; distinct from 1928 publication history. No full-text phenomenological argument audit; not a physical theory of cosmic flow.

title: Stream of Consciousness: Unity and Continuity in Conscious Experience
relevance: Contemporary comparator for temporally extended experience and unity/continuity.
limits: Reviewer located publisher record; edition corresponding to linked ISBN must be distinguished from original 2000 work. Book not audited.

title: Critique of Pure Reason, Transcendental Aesthetic
relevance: Time as form of inner sense and condition of appearances; transcendental rather than ordinary empirical idealism.
limits: English text located and reviewer checked A30-32/B46-49; 1781/1787 editions and translation distinctions matter. Whole argument not audited.

title: Time and Free Will: An Essay on the Immediate Data of Consciousness
relevance: Qualitative duration versus homogeneous measurable representation; philosophy of freedom and experience.
limits: 1910 F. L. Pogson translation of 1889 work located; reviewer checked selected excerpts, especially chapter II. Not an experimental refutation of clock time.

title: The Paradoxes of Time Travel
relevance: Personal versus external time, consistency and ability; distinguish paradox analysis from physical feasibility.
limits: Original metadata and excerpts checked by reviewer; no complete modal/ability reconstruction. Physical time machines not established.

title: Temporal Parts
relevance: Orientation to endurantism, perdurantism, stage theory and variable 3D/4D terminology.
limits: Secondary overview, not primary verification of competing persistence theories; use cited original works before a research inference.

title: Time
relevance: Coverage checklist and primary bibliography for ontology, tense, topology, fatalism and time travel.
limits: Page identifies substantive revision 2025-12-04; selected overview/bibliography inspected. Not evidence that all surveyed arguments are correct.

title: Presentism
relevance: Coverage/checklist lead for presentist formulations and objections.
limits: Overview located; not a substitute for direct defenders and critics or primary physics audits.
